trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full read of thm:unit-root-iff-integrable including the displayed equivalence and both direction paragraphs. All ten categories judged clean.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: NOT A TRAP, reported separately - substantive and the strongest finding in this paper: the equivalence is vacuous as stated, and the .md's own two direction sentences show why. The backward direction 'produces a unit-root F-crystal via the identity Frobenius endomorphism' - the identity is bijective, so the left side is inhabited for EVERY H unconditionally. The forward direction 'uses the integration theorem to construct G from the skewed-Poisson datum' - but that datum is a hypothesis of the theorem, not something the unit-root condition supplies, so the right side is likewise inhabited unconditionally. The resolved Lean confirms it: both branches open with 'intro _' and discard the hypothesis. The theorem is True <-> True under its own hypotheses and says nothing about unit-root versus integrability.
